content:
Overview

Murcia is a city in Region of Murcia with a population of 460,000. A sunny city in southeastern Spain with a beautiful Baroque cathedral, rich agricultural heritage, and affordable living. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 285 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
